title: 第二十三章 喜忧参半的季军师第二十四章 养猪计划
content_zh:
“那季军师机缘不小，他得到的这本纸质书籍却在储物袋爆裂时，震散消除了那层仙法保护，所以很容易便看到这书籍中的内容。
这书籍中记载的仙法应该是某修毒仙门所拥有，该门仙法是以毒入道。
首先通过感应天地灵气入体后，便采用多种毒草用秘术炼制汁液为药引，然后吸纳入体内炼化。
待得灵气壮大后存于体内，不断增强筋脉内腑，最后完成凝气入门，进入凝气期第一层。
这种修炼之法可非正道，不像道、佛、儒修仙者那般步步为营，稳扎稳打的修炼，而是借助毒草之力，强行洗经伐髓，说起来这就是剑走偏锋之法。
这季军师除了有莫大机缘，并且也是一极其狠辣之人。
一是他不知道自己是否具有灵根，便敢于尝试，他若无灵根，把内力当作感应成的灵气，些毒草之汁液一入体，那立即便死了。
二是这门功法正与他的灵根属性相配，否则也是极难成功。
他得到书籍后，自是高兴的便打算修炼，但这门仙法是以毒入道，书籍开篇里就记录了秘方配制之法。
像这种入门级的修仙小配方，自然不会是什么太难寻的珍贵草药，但这也是针对仙门而言，配方里所需的几种草药在凡人中却就极其难见了。
不过，对于常年行走在深山原始森林的“寻仙一脉”来说，倒也还不算太难，季军师很快寻到了大部分草药，但最后依然有两种草药无法寻到。
而这两种草药就是重要的调和药力所使用的，否则在吸收时，因无法中和毒草之力，便会让吸收汁液之气的人痛苦异常。”
李言默默无语，他此刻终于知道为什么自己修炼那么痛苦了，原来是少了调和药力的草药所致。
“当初季军师持续寻找几年后，终于又找到一种药草，只是最后一种草药却无论如何也找不到了，这时他的狠辣性格表现无疑。
他在缺少一种药草时，并且尚未确定自己是否身具灵根的情况下，便开始了引药入体的修炼。
冥冥之中自有注定，功法和他的灵根都是吻合，虽然过程痛苦，但经过七七四十九天修炼后，他竟然成功迈入了凝气期第一层。
然而，他不知仙门的这种入门的配方，虽然是低级的不能再低级了，可却已是经过上万年，乃至十几万年，甚至是上百万年千锤百炼摸索出来的。
早已精简的不能再精简了，每一味药草都有其特殊的功用，不能因为不是主药材，只是辅助药材就可以忽略缺少。
他这般强行修炼，虽然进级到了凝期气第一层，但已是埋下了祸患。
那些因少了一味调和药力，于是不少残留药力便存在了体内，时间一长就会火毒滋生。

起初，倒没有什么太多表向与症状，但随着季军师修炼的逐步提高，数年后，体内那部分没炼化而残留的药力，自行慢慢壮大，形成了火毒。
刚开始的表现就像你前段时间的感觉一样，气烦气闷，神情烦躁，但这时他已修炼到了第二层，所以已能用法力压制。
他以为随着修炼的提升，最终体内法力是可以清除这些火毒的，就这样他边修炼，边寻找能够清心宁神的法子。
他通过那本入门纸质书籍介绍，知道必须要修炼到凝气期第三层后，神识才能离体，那样才能阅读玉简和玉书里面的东西。
所以他在无法打开玉书和玉简时，便不知道其中是否有解决的法子了，于是找了最简单的方法，如去冰冷的荒原静坐，沉浸于乐器之中等。
就这样竟然让他生生的修炼的凝气期第三层，当他神识可以离体后，便兴冲冲地急忙用神识来阅读玉书和玉简。
玉书他自是无法打开，当他打开玉简时，首先得知了这玉简和纸质书籍是一套功法，当然更加兴奋，想着应该能从中找到解决之法，但最终结果让他大惊失色。
这玉简的前面记录该仙法四至十层的凝气口诀，玉简后面还真的重点说明了使用配方修炼的好处和弊端。
好处就不说了，弊端就是所用配方不当而强行修炼，其结果就是体内会产生火毒，而此火毒会伴随着体内灵力而不断滋养生长。
到了后来自身法力也无法压制，到了凝气期第三层顶峰时，体内的火毒会以疯狂的速度倍增。
根本不会再给修炼之人任何机会，当即发作，让修炼该功法之人气血逆流、爆体而亡。
但若你想不修炼，就保持在凝气期三层顶峰以下，那也是妄想了，这火毒每天都在滋生增强，必须通过不断修炼提高自己的境界，才能压制得住，这无疑于就是饮鸩止渴。
修仙界，尤其是传承了数千、上万年的门派，有哪个门派对自己功法没有一套保护措施，那怕只是最低级的入门功法，也会针对性的做些手脚的。
所以不在纸质书籍里说明这些，就是怕纸质书籍不小心流落外界，等你后期发现已然为时已晚，等待他们的下场就是惨死一条路。
content_en:
"The third military advisor had a good chance. The paper book he got was shattered when the storage bag exploded, eliminating the layer of fairy protection, so it was easy to see the contents of the book.
The immortal method recorded in this book should be owned by a certain poison-cultivating immortal sect, which uses poison to enter the Tao.
First, after sensing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into the body, a variety of poisonous herbs are used to refine the juice using secret techniques as medicine, and then it is absorbed into the body for refining.
After the spiritual energy is strong and stored in the body, it will continue to strengthen the muscles and internal organs, and finally complete the entry of Qi condensation and enter the first level of Qi condensation stage.
This kind of cultivation method is not the right way. It is not like Taoism, Buddhism, and Confucianism cultivators who practice step by step and practice steadily. Instead, they use the power of poisonous weeds to forcibly cleanse the meridians and cut the marrow. Speaking of it, this is the method of taking a slanted sword.
In addition to having a great opportunity, this Ji strategist is also an extremely ruthless person.
First, he didn't know whether he had spiritual roots, so he dared to try. If he didn't have spiritual roots and used his internal energy as the induced spiritual energy, he would die immediately as soon as the juice of some poisonous weeds entered his body.
The second is that this skill matches his spiritual root attributes, otherwise it will be extremely difficult to succeed.
After he got the book, he was happy and planned to practice it. However, this immortal method uses poison to enter the Tao, and the secret recipe is recorded in the beginning of the book.
A small entry-level recipe for cultivating immortals like this would naturally not be a precious herb that is too difficult to find, but this is also for the Immortal Sect, and the several herbs required in the formula are extremely rare among mortals.
However, it was not too difficult for the "Xunxian Lineage" who walked in the deep mountains and primeval forests all year round. Ji Junshi quickly found most of the herbs, but in the end there were still two herbs that could not be found.
These two herbs are used to reconcile the power of the medicine. Otherwise, when absorbed, the power of the poisonous herbs will not be neutralized, and the person who absorbs the juice will suffer abnormally. "
Li Yan was silent. At this moment, he finally understood why his practice was so painful. It turned out to be the lack of herbs to reconcile the power of the medicine.
"After Ji Junshi continued to search for several years, he finally found another herb, but the last herb could not be found anyway. At this time, his ruthless character was undoubtedly revealed.
When he was short of a medicinal herb and had not yet determined whether he had spiritual roots, he began the practice of introducing medicinal herbs into his body.
It was destined, and the technique matched his spiritual roots. Although the process was painful, after seven or forty-nine days of practice, he successfully entered the first level of the Qi Condensation Stage.
However, he did not know that although the entry-level formula of the Immortal Sect was as low-level as it could be, it had been worked out after tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands, or even millions of years of hard work.
What has already been streamlined cannot be streamlined any more. Each medicinal herb has its own special function. Just because it is not the main medicinal ingredient, but just an auxiliary medicinal ingredient, the lack of it cannot be ignored.
Although he had advanced to the first level of Condensation Qi through such forced cultivation, he had already laid the foundation for disaster.
Those who lack the power of the blending medicine, so a lot of residual medicine exists in the body, and over time, fire poison will breed.
At first, there weren't many symptoms or symptoms, but as Ji Junshi's practice gradually improved, a few years later, the remaining medicinal power in the body that had not been refined gradually grew on its own, forming fire poison.
At first, his behavior was just like how you felt some time ago, feeling annoyed and stuffy, and looking irritable. But by this time, he had reached the second level of cultivation, so he could suppress it with magic power.
He thought that with the improvement of his practice, the magic power in his body would eventually be able to remove these fire poisons. In this way, while practicing, he looked for ways to calm his mind and calm his mind.
Through the introductory paper book, he knew that he had to practice to the third level of the Qi Condensation Stage before his spiritual consciousness could leave the body, so that he could read the contents of the jade slips and jade books.
So when he couldn't open the jade book and jade slip, he didn't knowI wondered if there was a solution to this problem, so I looked for the simplest method, such as going to the cold wilderness to sit quietly and immersing myself in musical instruments.
This actually made him reach the third level of the Qi Condensation Stage of lifelong cultivation. When his spiritual consciousness could leave the body, he happily hurriedly used his spiritual consciousness to read jade books and jade slips.
He couldn't open the jade book. When he opened the jade slip, he first learned that the jade slip and the paper book were a set of exercises. Of course, he was even more excited, thinking that he should be able to find a solution from it, but the final result shocked him.
The front of this jade slip records the Qi condensation formulas for the fourth to tenth levels of the immortal method. The back of the jade slip really focuses on explaining the benefits and drawbacks of using the formula to practice.
Not to mention the benefits, the disadvantage is that the improper formula and forced practice will produce fire poison in the body, and this fire poison will continue to nourish and grow along with the spiritual power in the body.
Later, his own magic power will not be able to suppress it. When he reaches the peak of the third level of the Qi Condensation Stage, the fire poison in his body will multiply at a crazy speed.
It will not give the practitioner any chance, and it will happen immediately, causing the practitioner's energy and blood to flow backwards, causing the body to explode and die.
But if you want to stay below the peak of the third level of the Qi Condensation Stage without practicing, that is also a delusion. This fire poison is growing and strengthening every day, and you must improve your realm through continuous practice in order to suppress it. This is undoubtedly drinking poison to quench your thirst.
In the world of cultivating immortals, especially the sects that have been inherited for thousands or tens of thousands of years, there is no sect that does not have a set of protective measures for its own skills. Even if it is just the lowest entry level skills, they will do some targeted manipulation.
So if you don't explain this in paper books, you are afraid that the paper books will be accidentally lost to the outside world. By the time you find out later, it is already too late, and the fate waiting for them will be a tragic death.
